notes.title: 2024 Wrap-up of JIANGHU CHRONICLES Is Here!
notes.content:
Notice: This game only supports Chinese languages for the time being. We will try to add more languages in the future.

JIANGHU CHRONICLES is a Wuxia-themed clan simulator, which focuses on simulating Jianghu clans and experiencing realistic battle. The development team consists of only 2 people.
